A college sophomore and a retiree were talking together about risk-taking, specifically focusing on risky behavior like starting fights. The college sophomore never gets into fights and avoids them at all costs, while the retiree ends up in fights pretty often, and is usually the one who started it. Who is a risk-taker?
A. The college sophomore
B. Not enough info
C. The retiree
